app_info.subtitle: Publish and analyse blog content
app_info.description: Misar.Blog lets users draft, publish and update articles and series, manage comments, reactions and newsletter subscribers, generate cover images, and read traffic and revenue analytics — from ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can create, update, send, schedule or otherwise change Misar.Blog state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reaches the hosted Misar.Blog API over the network, so results depend on live account state outside this conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, revoke or irreversibly overwrite anything; any change it makes can be undone by a subsequent call.
